---
title: Test
format:
  epub:
    epub-title-page: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    epub:
      ensureEpubFileRegexMatches:
        - path: EPUB/content.opf
          regexes:
            - []
            - ["title_page"]
---

`epub-title-page: false` set in YAML reaches Pandoc, so no title page is generated.
